classes.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE Category = 'IFCSYSTEM') AS Systems, count(*) FILTER (WHERE Category LIKE 'IFCFLOW%') AS FlowElements, count(*) AS Entities FROM EntityText

memberOf.sql: SELECT b.Category AS GroupClass, count(*) AS Relations FROM RelationText r JOIN EntityText b ON b.EntityIndex = r.EntityIndexB WHERE r.RelationType = 'MemberOf' GROUP BY b.Category ORDER BY Relations DESC
